title: Decky Direct Updater: Keep your Decky plugins up to date
description: Find stable GitHub releases for Decky plugins, choose when to update, and discover more without leaving Gaming Mode.
hero_intro: Find new releases on GitHub, update your installed plugins, and discover new ones without leaving Gaming Mode.
copy_success: Copied! Paste the installation URL into Decky.
copy_error: Select the installation URL and copy it manually.
updates_text: Install a plugin once. Its developer can keep publishing fixes and new versions on GitHub. Direct Updater identifies installed plugins, looks for their GitHub repositories, and checks for compatible stable releases. You choose which updates to install.
updates_full: View the full-size pending updates screenshot
updates_alt: The Updates tab showing pending updates for installed plugins, with current and new versions.
details_full: View the full-size plugin details screenshot
details_alt: Plugin details showing the installed version, latest release, GitHub source and Update button.
step1: In Decky Settings → General, turn on Developer Mode.
step2: Open Decky Settings → Developer → Install Plugin from URL.
step2_confirm: Paste the copied URL, select Install and confirm in Decky.
step3: Select Direct Updater in the Decky sidebar.
zip_after: and use Decky's Install Plugin from ZIP File option.
find_text: Search by plugin name or GitHub repository, check the owner and repository details, choose a compatible release, and request installation from Gaming Mode. Not every GitHub repository contains a compatible Decky plugin.
trust: Direct Updater complements the official Decky Store and is useful for plugins whose developers publish on GitHub. GitHub releases may not have passed Store review. Install only from developers you trust. A compatible release ZIP is required.
community: Independent community project, not affiliated with Decky Loader.
developers_text: Publish releases on GitHub? Recommend Direct Updater so your users can find updates, without building and maintaining your own updater.
